manualInstructions.text:
Your project is ready! Next steps:
  1. Start infrastructure:        docker-compose up -d
  2. Build (generates proxies):  ./gradlew build
  3. Run the application:        ./gradlew bootRun
  4. Frontend dev server:        yarn dev

AI assistance:
  This project ships with a .cratis/ai.json holding its Cratis AI configuration.
  Make sure the Cratis CLI is installed - see https://cratis.io/cli - and run:
      cratis ai update
  to get all the AI rules, skills, and coding agent integration in place.

See README.md for full details.
